explain.say: A spacewalk suit is a tiny spacecraft shaped like a person. Its layers do three jobs: keep air pressure on the body, control temperature, and protect against tiny flying specks of rock and debris.

explain.say: Space has no air pressure, so without a suit body fluids would start to boil and the lungs couldn't work. An airtight bladder, held in shape by a restraint layer, keeps oxygen pressed around the astronaut.

faq.q: Why does a space suit need to be pressurised?
faq.a: In the vacuum of space there is no air pressure to keep body fluids liquid and let the lungs take in oxygen. The suit's airtight bladder holds oxygen around the body at about a third of normal air pressure.
asks: What would happen in space without a space suit?

faq.q: How do astronauts keep cool in a space suit?
faq.a: They wear a liquid cooling garment, long underwear threaded with thin tubes of cold water. The backpack chills the water, which carries body heat away during hard work.
asks: Do astronauts get hot in space suits?

faq.q: How does a space suit protect from micrometeoroids?
faq.a: The outer layers are made of tough fabrics including Kevlar and Nomex blends, which stop tiny high-speed specks of dust and debris from punching through.
asks: What is the outside of a space suit made of?

faq.q: How do astronauts breathe in a space suit?
faq.a: The backpack supplies pure oxygen and removes the carbon dioxide they breathe out using chemical filters. Because the suit is at low pressure, astronauts first breathe pure oxygen to clear nitrogen from their blood.
asks: Where does the air in a space suit come from?

faq.a: White reflects most sunlight, which helps stop the astronaut overheating in direct sun. It also makes them easy to see against the blackness of space.
asks: What colour are space suits and why?

facts: NASA's spacewalk suit runs at about 4.3 pounds per square inch, roughly 30 percent of sea-level air pressure.
Spacewalks from the International Space Station often last six to eight hours.

quiz.say: Which layer of a space suit carries body heat away?

options.show: The cooling garment with water tubes
options.say: The cooling garment with water tubes

quiz.why: Cold water pumped through tubes in the cooling garment soaks up body heat and carries it to the backpack.
